scope: Prompt S7 - Universal append-only audit ledger with cryptographic SHA-256 hash chaining, staff activity system, security anomaly detection, alert triage lifecycle, in-app notification center, and multi-channel delivery failure isolation.

gateEvidence.canonicalTestSuitePassed: Master test runner exit 0: 47/47 suites, 403 tests passing 100% cleanly.
gateEvidence.appendOnlyAuditLedgerTamperEvidence: Cryptographic SHA-256 hash chaining links each event to previous_event_hash; manual mutation of database rows is instantly detected by verifyAuditChainIntegrity as verified in test/security/audit_activity_alerts.test.js.
gateEvidence.secretAndSensitiveDataScrubbing: PINs, passwords, session tokens, PANs, and CVVs are automatically scrubbed and redacted before ledger persistence and hash calculation.
gateEvidence.roleScopedAuditViewing: Managers/Owners can query venue-wide audit logs with rich filters; Staff roles (Cashier, Waiter, Barista) are strictly restricted to their own actor_user_id.
gateEvidence.staffActivitySummaryStatutoryPayrollIsol: Staff activity endpoint returns operational performance metrics with an explicit policy notice prohibiting automatic statutory payroll deductions without manager review.
gateEvidence.securityAnomalyAlertsAndDeduplication: Detects failed PIN bursts (>=3 in 5m), revoked access attempts, rapid role changes, abnormal void surges (>=5 in 15m), and unknown payment bursts with sliding-window deduplication and full acknowledgement/resolution lifecycle.
gateEvidence.inAppNotificationCenterAndAttribution: Interactive notification center bell with unread badge counter in nav header and Arabic staff attribution badge in footer across all screens.
gateEvidence.multiChannelNotificationDeliveryFailureI: External webhook, email, and SMS connectors queue outbound alerts asynchronously with retry backoff and failure isolation without blocking core financial or POS transactions.

openFindings.summary: Prompt S7 universal audit ledger, security anomaly alerts, in-app notifications, and multi-channel outbox fully implemented and verified.

fixtures.reproducibilityNote: Fixtures are regenerated from code via npm run db:fixtures; embedded business dates and bcrypt salts make byte-level hashes vary between regeneration runs, but structure and seed logic are deterministic and verified by the suite.
